engine: Python mirt 1.2.0; native MAP, GH61, tol1e-4, max_iter500, unchanged default priors and original estimator; no R.

scope.data: Complete independent binary; local independence, no DIF
scope.exclude: No J30, N outside exactly3000, nonnormal latent, multidimensional or missing-data generalization.

seeds.construction: SeedSequence([root,model3or4,replicate,inner]); model and stages disjoint. No prior A-H seeds reused.

reuse: Shared native calibration per seed cached as synthetic responses, physical coefficients/full covariance, labels, native raw S-X2 and public GH241 pattern EAP/SD when needed. Preserve failures; never refit unchanged seed. Bootstrap full native refits shared by P1 and P3. Exact response-pattern probabilities/scores cached. Confirmations remain independent of development.

development.purpose: Method feasibility and benchmarks only; NEVER certification

baseline_confirmation.purpose: P3 original chi-square calibration and independent P2 exact-pattern calibration; P1 may reuse eligible frozen base fits without duplicate calibration

bootstrap_confirmation.launch_rule: Only if development establishes technically valid binding inversion and within remaining wall-clock projection; preregister fixed selected method before launch. No scientific results from confirmation inspected for method selection.

P1.method: Parametric-bootstrap binding-function inversion with full joint score-sensitivity Jacobian, not A1/G/H covariance or a prior-score shift.
P1.coordinates: Exact native box-logit, MAP point remains physical native fit; no density-Jacobian prior.
P1.bootstrap: Generate under fitted marginal null; use multinomial pattern counts only when GH241/GH481 mass L1 <=1e-8 and independent integration check passes, otherwise latent-normal + Bernoulli generation. Every bootstrap dataset gets native full MAP refit. No unvalidated approximate refit.
P1.score_identity: D_eta E_eta[T(X)]=Cov_eta(T(X), likelihood_score_eta(X)), with T=transformed native MAP. Estimate full joint binding Jacobian from B full refits and likelihood scores at generating fit.
P1.control_variate: J=Veta Ieta + Cov_boot(Tstar-Tlinear, scorestar), where Tlinear=eta_hat+Veta(scorestar+prior_score_eta) and Ieta exact marginal expected Fisher from response enumeration. Control variate reduces Monte Carlo noise; no arbitrary shrinkage or pseudoinverse.
P1.interval: Binding inversion draws eta_hat + solve(J,eta_hat-eta_star). Take fixed .025/.975 quantiles, map exactly to physical boxes. Native MAP point unchanged; MAP sampling SE is SD of full bootstrap PHYSICAL estimates, not CI width or posterior SD. Report binding-inverted center separately.
P1.failures: Refuse nonsingular/condition-number gate violations (kappa>1e8), saturated/boundary coordinates, native nonconvergence or >1% failed bootstrap refits. Do not replace failed draws. Gaussian analytical identity test required before actual calibration.

gates.SE_accuracy: Report bootstrap mean-square SE against empirical per-item MAP sampling variance and calibration-cluster uncertainty; no SE certification merely from CI coverage.

P1.development_decision: Assess native API, covariance/score identities, numerical conditioning, binding nonlinearity and runtime. Grossly invalid/unstable inversion is rejected, not silently rescaled. If infeasible or scientifically failed, preserve records and prioritize P2/P3 rather than repeating unchanged.

P2.posterior: Preserve public native GH241 EAP/SD. Independently compute marginal probabilities, moments, CDF and .025/.975 equal-tailed posterior bounds under K=true items and F=independently calibrated MAP items.
P2.integration: Normal-prior theta grid[-10,10], dyadic .02/.01/.005 convergence until weighted coverage change<=1e-4 and interval-bound change<=1e-3; independently check moments GH241/GH481 and native F<=1e-6. No guessed quantiles or normal-Wald substitute.
P2.metrics: Exact pattern-weighted bias/RMSE, marginal and theta-grid/tail coverage; calibration dataset is MC cluster, never persons or parameter draws.
P2.exact_frequentist: Invert exact Poisson-binomial raw-score tails at .025 via monotonic root finding, using enumerated equivalent raw-score probabilities. Allow +/-infinity where 3PL/4PL asymptotes prevent rejection. Known-item exact coverage is distinct from fitted-item coverage. Never invoke Wilks.
P2.theta_grid: 21 prespecified theta values linspace(-4,4,21); tail subsets theta<=-2 or >=2 and separate unconditional theta regions.

gates.oracle_efficiency: Upper simultaneous95% CI of excess F MSE relative to K must be <=5% of K Bayes risk (retain at least95% oracle measurement precision); new criterion fixed before data, not inferred from observed errors.

P2.uncertainty: Bonferroni t intervals over calibration clusters for P2 declared family (models x marginal credible coverage/bias/efficiency and exact-CI conditional grid/tails); report approximate MC intervals. Raw-score F frequentist claim only where lower simultaneous bound >=.95; K exact result is mathematical, not a fitted-item guarantee. Credible intervals retain Bayesian label.

P3.primary: Evaluate ORIGINAL native mirt.itemfit S_X2 statistic, df, raw p on independently refitted null datasets; preserve library raw-score grouping and sparse-cell collapsing.
P3.multiple_claims: 24 model-item primary null rejection rates; simultaneous one-sided exact CP with alpha=.05/24, plus dataset-cluster pooled MCSE.

gates.interpretation: Scoped approximate alpha=.05 size calibration allowing the project's fixed 2-percentage-point absolute error budget; NOT exact global size or all-alpha superuniformity. Report conservative behavior rather than falsely claiming uniform p.
gates.failure_sensitivity: Treat non-evaluable tests as rejections in worst-case Type-I bounds; never silently drop.

P3.replacement: Only if baseline fails: use fitted-null parametric bootstrap with native full MAP refit, rebuild raw-score groups/collapsing and recompute S_X2 for each bootstrap. p=(1+exceedances)/(B+1), B399 fixed. Bootstrap fits already generated for P1 can be shared. No frozen-fit-only certification or df correction. Full-refit baseline retained.
P3.power: Optional fresh local-dependence alternative only after size gates and if affordable; no power claim from null.

production: Promote only output+method+exact declared scope supported by independent complete confirmation. Preserve old certifications and unsupported gates. No pilot certification. All errors, original failures, refusal/completion counts and source/data hashes retained.
execution: Bounded multiprocessing2/job; matrix max_parallel16. Global hard stop in numerical loops. Checkpoint fitted results and raw decisions; artifact/cache reuse on archive commits. CI execution PASS is never scientific PASS; no full local suite.
